title: Automated QIAcube DNA Extraction
author: Clemens Scherzer
materials: QIAamp spin column i. Lid Position: L1 b. Position
Empty i. Lid Position: Empty c. Position
1.5 mL Eppendorf tube i. Lid Position: L3 It is very important that the lids go in the proper positions or else the QIAcube will generate an error message!

Aliquot 284 µL, QIAgen Protease into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.* Place in microcentrifuge tube slot A in QIAcube. * If there are less than 12 samples load materials according to the QIAcube loading chart found in the QIAcube binder.

Set up rotor adaptor by placing following materials in the proper positions: a. Position 1: QIAamp spin column i. Lid Position: L1 b. Position 2: Empty i. Lid Position: Empty c. Position 3: 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube i. Lid Position: L3 It is very important that the lids go in the proper positions or else the QIAcube will generate an error message!

steps.title: Preheat water bath to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Set the water bath temperature to 37 °C and allow it to equilibrate before starting any further steps.

steps.title: Thaw Buffy Coat samples
steps.instruction: Place the frozen Buffy Coat tubes in the 37 °C water bath and gently agitate each tube until fully thawed.

steps.title: Prepare QIAcube reagents
steps.instruction: Turn on the QIAcube, open its door, remove the reagent tray, unscrew all caps and refill each reagent up to but not exceeding the fill line on the bottle. Then reinstall the tray and arrange reagents in the specified positions:

steps.title: Load disposable tips
steps.instruction: Insert a fresh set of 1000 µL tips and a fresh set of 200 µL disposable tips into the QIAcube tip racks.

steps.title: Set up rotor adaptors
steps.instruction: Lay out the rotor adaptors on the holding tray and label the tray "DNA".

steps.title: Load rotor adaptors into centrifuge
steps.instruction: Place the rotor adaptors into the QIAcube centrifuge. If processing fewer than 12 samples, follow the QIAcube loading chart found in the QIAcube binder to determine the correct positions.

steps.title: Aliquot Buffy Coat into sample tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of each Buffy Coat into a Sample Tube RB, aspirating as much of the Buffy Coat as possible to maximize yield.

steps.title: Load sample tubes into QIAcube
steps.instruction: Insert the Sample Tubes RB into the QIAcube sample tray. For fewer than 12 samples, arrange them according to the QIAcube loading chart in the binder.

steps.title: Run DNA isolation Part A
steps.instruction: Close the QIAcube door and start the program: DNA → QIAamp DNA Blood Mini → blood or body fluid → DNA isolation Part A.

steps.title: Post‑Part A handling
steps.instruction: After Part A completes, perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Remove the rotor adaptors from the centrifuge and place them on the sample‑holding tray, keeping each adaptor in the numbered position that matches its previous centrifuge location.
Move the QIAamp spin column from its 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube to Position 1 of the QIAcube with the lid placed in Position L1 (Part A step 6).
Remove the 1.5 mL tube now containing the DNA, cap it, and label it with a Freezerbondz label "DNA‑01".
Add a fresh 1.5 mL tube to the rotor adaptor in Position 3 and place its lid in Position L3 (Part A step 6).
Return the rotor adaptors to the centrifuge, ensuring each adaptor is placed in the same numbered position as before.

steps.title: Load fresh 200 µL tips
steps.instruction: Insert a new set of 200 µL disposable tips into the QIAcube tip rack.

steps.title: Run Elution Part B
steps.instruction: Close the QIAcube lid and start the program: DNA → QIAamp DNA Blood Mini → blood or body fluid → Add Elution Part B.

steps.title: Collect second eluate DNA‑02
steps.instruction: When the program finishes, discard the QIAamp spin column, remove the 1.5 mL tube from Position 3, and label it with a Freezerbondz label "DNA‑02".

steps.title: Combine eluates and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume of DNA‑02 into the DNA‑01 tube and pipette up and down several times to obtain a homogeneous DNA mixture.

steps.title: Split DNA into two 200 µL aliquots
steps.instruction: Divide the combined DNA solution into two separate 200 µL aliquots.

steps.title: Aliquot for concentration assay
steps.instruction: Pipette 3 µL of DNA into a 1.5 mL tube for Cary concentration measurement. If the assay is not performed immediately, store the tube at –20 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot for gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL of DNA into a PCR tube for loading on a 0.7 % agarose gel to verify DNA presence and size. If not run immediately, store the tube at –20 °C.
